s: Additionally, several states and localities have enacted measures related to the use of artificial intelligence and machine learning in products and services.
For example, in Europe, there is a proposed regulation related to artificial intelligence (“AI”) that, if adopted, could impose onerous obligations related to the use of AI-related systems.
